en.headline: MTR sets 24 October as Thank You Day with half-price rides
en.dek: Octopus, JoyYou Card and QR-code journeys on heavy rail, Light Rail and selected MTR buses will be half-price, including Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau cross-boundary trips.
body: The MTR Corporation announced on Tuesday that it will designate Saturday 24 October as a Thank You Day under the fare-adjustment mechanism’s service-performance rebate arrangement.

On that day, passengers using an Octopus or JoyYou Card on MTR heavy-rail lines, Light Rail and MTR buses serving the north-west New Territories, or paying by QR code on the heavy-rail network, will pay half the normal fare. The concession covers East Rail Line journeys to and from Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau stations and can be combined with interchange discounts, concessionary stations, Monthly Pass connecting-journey discounts and the government’s $2 concessionary fare scheme for eligible elderly and disabled passengers.

Half-price does not apply to East Rail Line first-class travel, Airport Express, MTR feeder buses, single-journey tickets (physical or electronic), contactless credit or debit cards, or the high-speed rail Hong Kong section.
The corporation said extra staff would be deployed at stations and train services closely monitored, with adjustments made as needed.

zh.headline: 港鐵10月24日設感謝日 八達通乘車半價
zh.dek: 當日使用八達通、樂悠咭或二維碼乘搭港鐵、輕鐵及指定巴士可享半價，包括羅湖及落馬洲過境車程。
body: 港鐵公司周二公布，按照票價調整機制下的「服務表現回贈」安排，將於10月24日（星期六）設「感謝日」，向乘客提供半價乘車優惠。
當日使用八達通或樂悠咭乘搭港鐵、輕鐵及行走新界西北路線的港鐵巴士，或以二維碼乘搭重鐵網絡車程，均可享車費半價。優惠包括東鐵綫來往羅湖及落馬洲站的過境車程，並可與轉乘優惠、特惠站、全月通連接車程七五折優惠及政府長者及合資格殘疾人士二元優惠計劃同時使用。
半價優惠不包括東鐵綫頭等、機場快綫、港鐵接駁巴士、實體或電子單程票、感應式信用卡或扣賬卡付費車程，以及高速鐵路（香港段）。
港鐵表示當日會加派人手在車站協助乘客，並密切監察列車運作及車站情況，按需要適時調整服務及人手安排。
